transitionDuration.title: Transition Duration
transitionDuration.description: Open & close transition duration in seconds (default: 3 seconds)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable updating humidity sensors via web calls

accessoryID.title: Accessory ID
accessoryID.description: Unique ID for the Accessory (https://www.random.org/). Do not modify once assigned!

accessoryName.title: Accessory Name
accessoryName.description: Accessory name as it will be displayed in HomeKit

heatingThresholdCelsius.title: Heating Threshold ºC *
heatingThresholdCelsius.description: Temperature level below which the heater turns on (0ºC - 25ºC)

coolingThresholdCelsius.title: Cooling Threshold ºC *
coolingThresholdCelsius.description: Temperature level above which the cooler (AC) turns on (10ºC - 35ºC)

heatingThresholdFahrenheit.title: Heating Threshold ºF *
heatingThresholdFahrenheit.description: Temperature level below which the heater turns on (32ºF - 77ºF)

coolingThresholdFahrenheit.title: Cooling Threshold ºF *
coolingThresholdFahrenheit.description: Temperature level above which the cooler (AC) turns on (50ºF - 95ºF)

properties.title: Note: The heating threshold value **must be lower** than the cooling threshold value

humidifierThreshold.title: Humidifying Threshold *
humidifierThreshold.description: Humidity level below which the humidifier turns on (0% - 100%)

dehumidifierThreshold.title: Dehumidifying Threshold *
dehumidifierThreshold.description: Humidity level above which the dehumidifier turns on (0% - 100%)

properties.title: Note: The humidifier threshold value **must be lower** than the dehumidifier threshold value

colorTemperatureKelvin.title: Color Temperature *
colorTemperatureKelvin.description: Color temperature in Kelvin (2200 K to 6500 K)

autoSecurityTimeout.title: Auto Security Timeout *
autoSecurityTimeout.description: Lock auto-lock time in seconds (0 = off)

armedModes.title: Available Armed States *
armedModes.description: Armed states available to this security system

properties.title: Note: The default state **must be** either 'Disarmed' or one of the available armed states

hasResetTimer.title: Has a Reset Timer
hasResetTimer.description: Switch resets to default state when timer ends

hasCompanionSensor.title: Has a Companion Sensor
hasCompanionSensor.description: Switch triggers a sensor when its state changes

muteLogging.title: Mute Logging
muteLogging.description: Log information will only be visible when runninhg in debug mode

duration.title: Runtime
duration.description: Valve auto shut-off time (1hr max - 0 = manual off)

type.title: Type *
type.description: Sensor type (Critical sensor notifications bypass 'Do Not Disturb' focus mode)

durationRandomMin.title: Min Duration
durationRandomMin.description: Minimum timer reset delay (7 days max)

durationRandomMax.title: Max Duration
durationRandomMax.description: Maximum timer reset delay (7 days max)

properties.title: Note: The minimum duration value **must be shorter** than the maximum duration value

isResettable.title: Is Resettable
isResettable.description: The timer is reset every time the accessory is triggered, even if the state of the accessory does not change

name.title: Name *
name.description: Sensor name as it will be displayed in HomeKit

type.title: Type *
type.description: Sensor type triggered by accessory state change (Critical sensor notifications bypass 'Do Not Disturb' focus mode)

host.title: Host *
host.description: IP address (142.250.178.4) or domain name (www.google.com) of host to ping

failureRetryCount.title: Retries Before Failure *
failureRetryCount.description: Failed ping count before triggering the sensor

pattern.title: Cron Pattern *
pattern.description: Unix cron pattern (minute, hour, day, month, weekday)

zoneId.title: Zone Id
zoneId.description: Zone id (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones). Defaults to system zone id

disableTriggerEventLogging.title: Disable Trigger Event Logging
disableTriggerEventLogging.description: Disable logging for high frequency trigger events

offset.title: Time Offset
offset.description: Minutes before (-) or after (+) the event

zoneId.title: Zone Id
zoneId.description: Zone id (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones). Defaults to system zone id

properties.description: Note: You can reorder accessories by dragging them to a new location in the list. Click the 'Save' button to update the configuration.
